guides.title: NaProTechnology: A Clinician's Guide
guides.description: NaProTechnology diagnoses and treats the underlying conditions driving infertility, menstrual disorders, and early pregnancy loss. This guide covers how the method works, published outcomes data, how to find a qualified provider, and what to expect on cost and insurance.

guides.title: Creighton Model FertilityCare System (CrMS)
guides.description: A standardized, instructor-taught way to chart cervical-mucus biomarkers that doubles as a clinical record. The same Creighton chart that helps couples avoid or achieve pregnancy is the diagnostic input a NaProTechnology physician reads to identify and treat underlying conditions.
guides.og_description: How the Creighton Model (CrMS) cervical-mucus charting method works, what the evidence says about effectiveness, and how the chart serves as the diagnostic record for NaProTechnology.

guides.title: What is FEMM?
guides.description: FEMM (Fertility Education and Medical Management) teaches women to monitor hormonal biomarkers and connects them with trained providers who diagnose and treat the underlying conditions driving their symptoms.
guides.og_description: Fertility Education and Medical Management -- a fertility awareness method and the clinical framework that grew from it.

guides.pageTitle: FEMM Method Explained: A Clinician's Guide
guides.pageDescription: FEMM uses biomarker charting and RHRI protocols to diagnose and treat hormonal and reproductive conditions. Learn how FEMM works and find a provider.

guides.title: What is NeoFertility?
guides.description: NeoFertility diagnoses and treats the underlying causes of infertility and recurrent miscarriage using cycle-based evaluation, immunological testing, and targeted treatment to restore natural conception.
guides.og_description: Dublin-based restorative reproductive medicine practice. Dr. Phil Boyle's approach to infertility and fertility care.

guides.title: Chronic Endometritis: The Missed Diagnosis Behind Recurrent Loss and Failed IVF
guides.description: Chronic endometritis is a persistent, low-grade inflammation of the uterine lining diagnosed by CD138 endometrial biopsy. It is frequently missed in recurrent miscarriage and implantation failure workups, and it is treatable with antibiotic therapy.

guides.title: Miscarriage and Recurrent Pregnancy Loss: A Clinician-Reviewed Guide
guides.description: Miscarriage affects approximately 15% of clinically confirmed pregnancies. Recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL), defined as two or more clinical losses, affects 2 to 5% of couples. Most causes are diagnosable and treatable. This guide covers what the standard workup misses, what RRM-trained clinicians evaluate, and what outcomes look like after cause-based treatment.
